jp_verse: 小さな穴を　子どもが覗き込み\n\n    見えない深さに　夏の風が落ちてゆく
en_verse: A child peered into a narrow hollow,\nwhile the summer wind fell into unseen depths.

jp_verse: 駆け抜けた草原に　夕陽が沈み\n\n    終わった遊びが　静かに光っていた
en_verse: Across the running field the sunset faded,\nand the finished game still glimmered quietly.

jp_verse: 花のそばに　静かに座る人\n\n    柔らかな風が　袖を揺らしていた
en_verse: Beside the flowers sat a quiet woman,\nwhile a gentle breeze stirred her sleeves.

jp_verse: 小さな手から　花が渡され\n\n    言葉より先に　心が微笑んでいた
en_verse: A flower passed from tiny hands,\nand the heart smiled before words appeared.

jp_verse: 水辺に映る　静かな姿\n\n    揺れる光だけが　本当を知っている
en_verse: A quiet figure reflected upon the water,\nwhile only trembling light knew the truth.

jp_verse: 眠る命を　腕に抱きながら\n\n    夜の静けさが　部屋を包み込んでいた
en_verse: Holding sleeping life within her arms,\nthe silence of night gently filled the room.

jp_verse: 重い石を　まっすぐに貫き\n\n    見えぬ力が　奥へ届いてゆく
en_verse: Straight through the heavy stone it passed,\nas unseen strength reached deeper within.

jp_verse: 幼い肩を　そっと抱き寄せ\n\n    夕暮れの道を　二人で見つめていた
en_verse: An older brother drew the child close,\nand together they watched the evening road.

jp_verse: 暗い煙が　手の中で揺れ\n\n    言えぬ思いが　胸を曇らせていた
en_verse: Dark smoke trembled within his hand,\nwhile unspoken thoughts clouded the heart.

jp_verse: 険しい岩に　指を掛けながら\n\n    一歩ずつ　空へ近づいてゆく
en_verse: Grasping the steep rock face,\nhe climbed one step closer to the sky.

jp_verse: 小さな影が　星空を見上げ\n\n    遠い光だけが　静かに降っていた
en_verse: A tiny figure gazed into the stars,\nwhile distant lights fell softly through the night.

jp_verse: 流れ星を　数える子どもたち\n\n    わずかな光が　夜を特別にしていた
en_verse: Children counted the falling stars,\nand a few brief lights made the night extraordinary.

jp_verse: 広い山々に　両手を広げ\n\n    沈む太陽を　胸いっぱいに迎えていた
en_verse: Upon the vast mountains he spread his arms wide,\nwelcoming the setting sun with all his heart.

jp_verse: 灯りのともる家に　夜が近づき\n\n    月の光が　静かな庭を照らしていた
en_verse: Night approached the house of lantern light,\nwhile the moon illuminated the silent garden.

jp_verse: 無数の灯が　湖へ流れ\n\n    人々の願いが　空へ昇ってゆく
en_verse: Countless lanterns drifted across the lake,\nas the wishes of many rose into the sky.

jp_verse: 波打つ浜辺に　夕焼けが残り\n\n    一日の終わりが　静かに寄せてきた
en_verse: The sunset lingered upon the shore,\nand the end of the day quietly approached.

jp_verse: 崖の先で　海を見つめながら\n\n    世界の広さが　胸に流れ込んできた
en_verse: Standing beyond the cliffs beside the sea,\nthe vastness of the world flowed into his heart.

jp_verse: 焚き火のそばで　名を呼び合い\n\n    夜空の下に　小さな物語が生まれた
en_verse: Beside the campfire they called each other's names,\nand beneath the stars a small story was born.

jp_verse: 滝のそばの石に　光が刻まれ\n\n    長い年月が　静かに眠っていた
en_verse: Light was carved upon the stone beside the waterfall,\nwhere long ages slept in silence.

jp_verse: 水面に揺れる　二つの影\n\n    似た光だけが　静かに重なっていた
en_verse: Two reflections trembled upon the water,\nwhile their shared light quietly became one.
